tests.detail: Halving every rupee for all 4 people kept every score the same (Ravi stayed at 85).
Doubling every rupee for all 4 people kept every score the same (Ravi stayed at 85).
Changing every name (and the owner's gender) in all 4 statements kept every score the same (Ravi stayed at 85).
Sunita earns about ₹12,502 a month and scores 99; Arjun earns about ₹40,079 a month and scores 43.
Adding a savings week never lowered a score (16 weeks checked across 4 people; each added up to 5.0 points).
Paying late bills on time never lowered a score (4 cases checked; up to 5.6 points gained).
Removing all of Sunita's bills marked bill payments as 'not available' (not zero) and moved the score from 99 to 99.

The score reads only these transaction fields: amount_paise, balance_paise, category, date, direction, flags, id, kind, payee_token. No name, gender, age, religion, caste, language or location is ever an input.
